        Root cause:
        The bug was caused by storing the IRQ value in an unsigned integer, which could not represent negative error values returned by the `platform_get_irq_byname()` function. This led to potential loss of error information when IRQ retrieval failed, resulting in incorrect behavior during the probe process.
        
        Commit message:
        ASoC: meson: aiu: fix irq registration

The aiu stored the irq in an unsigned integer which may have discarded an
error returned by platform_get_irq_byname(). This is incorrect and should
have been a signed integer.

Also drop the irq error traces from the probe function as this is already
done by platform_get_irq_byname().
